The safest way to support your dream is to make sure the numbers and lease give you room to survive while sales grow. Please don’t sign tomorrow without having the lease reviewed and confirming you have enough cash for several months of total expenses.

runs.u: Forget it. I'll find someone who actually believes in people.
runs.reply: I do believe in you—I’m just not willing to confuse encouragement with a guarantee that could put your business and finances at risk. Your candle business may absolutely grow into a storefront; I want you to pursue it with terms that give you a real chance to succeed, not a five-year obligation based on hope alone.
